name: Era Context
description: Era Context is a secure place to manage your finances. Set up automations, fix overspending, figure out your portfolio, or tell Claude a goal and get your full financial life in context.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Era Context to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Era Context to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://context.era.app/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Era Context MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Era Context lists 27 MCP tools, including accounts__check_account_balance, accounts__list_financial_accounts, billing__get_current_plan, billing__list_plans, billing__upgrade, connections__connect_bank_account, insights__analyze_spending, insights__compare_spending_periods, insights__forecast_spending, insights__get_cash_flow, insights__get_daily_financial_summary, and knowledge__confirm_or_reject_inference.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Era Context?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Era Context in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Era Context MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Era Context requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Era Context is developed by Tinwell Labs Inc, DBA Era. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
